title: An application customizer can select the string converter
summary: Reads HTTP bytes from a servlet response and an independent endpoint receiving the Boot-customized synchronous client’s request.

change.description: Boot orders its default string-converter customizer at zero so ordinary application customizers can replace its choice for both HTTP directions.

notes: Both deployments use the same released Tomcat 11.0.24 transport. Spring MVC and RestClient consume the original Boot server and client customizers in their declared order.
